audience.programmeDescription: The University of Amsterdam’s Spanish and Latin American Studies programme combines Spanish language, literature and cultural history with contemporary social and political inquiry. This example includes a semester at a Spanish or Latin American university, thirty free-choice credits and a supervised Spanish-language thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR provides substantial literary interpretation, language-processing research, historical and cultural analysis, and inquiry into identity, institutions and global power. These offer meaningful related study but do not combine into sustained study of Spanish and Latin American literature, regional cultural history, contemporary societies and language in those settings. The strongest complete programmes instead become general humanities or global social science. This conclusion concerns the programme’s defining academic substance, beyond Spanish-language proficiency alone.

curriculum.routeLabel: Spanish and Latin American Studies; study abroad pathway

componentNotes.spa-134121036y: A writing diagnostic and recurring tutoring accompany the programme without adding credits.
componentNotes.spa-134121306y: Participate in Spanish 1 before Spanish 2. Pass both before Spanish 3; Spanish 4 requires both passed and participation in Spanish 3.
componentNotes.spa-134121346y: Participate in Spanish 3 and 4 before this linguistic study of the Spanish-speaking world.
componentNotes.spa-134221246y: Pass Spanish 1–4 before Spanish 5. Spanish 6 requires Spanish 1–4 passed and participation in Spanish 5.
componentNotes.spa-134221356y: Pass Spanish 1–4 and an introductory literature course. Study key Spanish-language texts from the Middle Ages to the present.
componentNotes.spa-134221008y: The selected pathway includes thirty credits at a Spanish or Latin American university. Pass at least 54 first-year credits and participate in year-two semester one before departure. Part-time students go no earlier than year three. Students unable to travel for valid reasons require Examination Board approval for a thirty-credit home alternative.
componentNotes.spa-134221296y: Pass Spanish 5 and 6. Literary translation, intercultural strategies, interpreting and audiovisual exercises also require at least B2 Dutch.
componentNotes.spa-134221306y: Complete an introductory literature course or the earlier literary-perspectives course. Study Spanish-American stories, novels, poetry and songs through identity and otherness.
componentNotes.spa-134221316y: Participate in Spanish 5 and 6 before this sociolinguistic study of multilingualism in Spain, Latin America and the United States.
componentNotes.spa-approved-free-profiling-space: Thirty genuinely free credits may comprise university electives, an approved minor or an optional internship of at most twelve credits. Normally no more than twelve credits may be introductory, or twenty-four under the specified recognised UvA-minor or same-language exceptions. External study requires Examination Board approval and compulsory language study cannot be duplicated.
componentNotes.spa-134229012y: The individual twelve-credit thesis investigates a self-selected Spanish or Latin American language-and-culture topic under supervision and is written in Spanish. Positive first-year study advice or an exemption is required; follow the programme’s thesis registration and supervision procedures.
